Rule [R:WPS-006] requires that "Iron-zinc black passivation is specified as trivalent", based on PARI PRD-GD-DES-12 Row 4.

Finding [F5] fails because the surface treatment 'IZBP' in [TB:surface_treatment] does not explicitly state "trivalent". To fix this, the title block entry should be updated to specify the trivalent variant (e.g., "IZBP Trivalent") so it complies with [R:WPS-006].
